title: Figure 17. Atlas IIAS All-Mode Ship-Hit Contours with A = 3.00
description: Contour plot of "Crossrange Distance (nm)" versus "Downrange Distance (nm)" showing all-mode ship-hit probability contours at 10^-4, 10^-5 and 10^-6. The 10^-4 contour is a small closed lobe within about 10 nm downrange, while the 10^-5 and 10^-6 contours run beyond 25 nm. In-plot labels read "Atlas IIAS," "All Mode P_I," and "B = 1,000, A = 3.00."
